svg.title: Medical Knowledge Navigation in MedEvo
svg.desc: A schematic medical learning cycle, not a clinical case or measured result. A training question supplies observable clinical context. Each fresh failed rollout is diagnosed against four fixed error families, with five subtypes per family. A gold-blind auditor supplies an answer-free recovery cue. The same student keeps supported reasoning and regenerates only the suffix. Screened targets update medical supervision, with at most one active target per question. Each SFT round starts from the same M zero. A separate fixed feedback set supplies assessment signals, never training samples. Feedback shifts selection priorities across the fixed modality, anatomy, disease and difficulty axes. Answer-derived disease labels stay in planning metadata and never reach the auditor or hint. The next training question is diagnosed afresh. CT and histology contexts and highlighted priorities are illustrative.
